q: We just got scored on and our 5 takes the ball out. What spacing do we run up the floor?
answer: 5 Out, with the 5 trailing (Big Above)
wrong: 4 Out, with the 5 rim running (Big Ahead)
Walk it up and wait for a call
explain: Closest Man Inbounds/Outlets: if the 5 inbounds, he trails and we are 5 Out.

q: Someone other than the 5 inbounds. What does the 5 do?
answer: Rim runs (Big Ahead) and we set 4 Out
explain: If anyone else inbounds, the 5 rim runs (Big Ahead) and we set 4 Out spacing.

q: Pace is 1-3-8. What is the "3"?
answer: The ball crosses half court within 3 seconds (pass ahead or dribble)
explain: 1-3-8: inbound in 1 sec, ball crosses half in 3 secs.

q: You're the guard and you can't get the deep outlet. What do you do?
answer: C Cut: curve toward the ball, keeping your momentum going toward half court
wrong: Stop and post up your defender

q: Where do you catch the ball as the Deep Outlet?
answer: Butt to the sideline at free-throw line extended, after a peek down court
wrong: In the middle of the floor at the top of the key

q: Where does the Dunker sit?
answer: Short corner: heels on the baseline, outside the hash, wide and flat, weakside
wrong: In the deep corner behind the 3-point line

q: After a defensive miss our trailing big sets a transition ball screen right away. What is it called?
answer: Fist

q: What is "2up"?
answer: Double Drag: staggered transition ball screens, O5 sets the second one
wrong: A ball screen with two shooters in the corner

q: Race: what are we hunting in the first 6 seconds?
answer: Keys, 3s and frees (free throws)

q: In early offence, how do we sprint to our spots?
answer: WIDE then LONG, to the 5 spots in 5 seconds or less
wrong: Wait at half court for the call

q: The defence has all 5 back, loaded to the ball, and the ball defender is square. We are…
answer: Neutralized: flow into a Trigger right away
wrong: In a Scramble: make a .5 decision

q: The point guard calls "4 Down". What are we running?
answer: Block Mover

q: The point guard calls "2 side". What is it?
answer: Stagger

q: The point guard calls "Horns side". What is it?
answer: 5 Out Pistol

q: The point guard calls "0". What is it?
answer: Ball screen toward the open corner
wrong: Ball screen toward the filled corner

q: Ball screen where the handler goes toward 3 teammates. What is the call?
answer: C
explain: 0 = open side, Step = 1 teammate, Fist = 2, C = 3.

q: Who makes the Early Call, and what does he decide?
answer: The point guard: 4 Out or 5 Out, are we neutralized, which Core Trigger

q: You drive and two defenders come to you (E2). What do you do?
answer: Pass quickly to the open teammate
wrong: Pick up your dribble and pivot

q: You drive the paint and kick it out. What's your next job?
answer: Sprint and exit cut faster than you came in (KOGO)
wrong: Stay in the paint for the rebound
Set a screen for the shooter

q: The defence is scrambling. How long do you have to shoot, drive or pass?
answer: Half a second (.5)
wrong: Until a teammate calls for it

q: Grid Spacing: when can two players be in the same sector?
answer: Only during a purposeful action: a screen, hand-off or cut
wrong: Any time the ball is in the post
When the shot clock is under 10

q: 1v1 Advantage means…
answer: The defender's chest is not square to you
wrong: Chest to chest with your defender
You are taller than your man

q: Flow: what is the 2nd side?
answer: The ball crosses midline after the 1st side and we run a 2-man game

q: A ball screen is happening on the wing. What is a Burn cut?
answer: A baseline cut
explain: Burn: baseline cut. Jazz: wing cut.

q: You see the back of your defender's head. What do you do?
answer: Dive: cut hard to the basket right away

q: Exit (Klay Action) is…
answer: A Miami baseline pin screen during the PNR that pulls the tags away from the roller
wrong: A flare screen for the handler

q: Their defence keeps going under our ball screen. Which tag punishes it?
answer: Twist: re-screen

q: What is Stack?
answer: Spain PNR backscreen
wrong: A back screen for the big

q: 4 Point Line Spacing: where do you stand in the slot?
answer: About 3 feet behind the FIBA 3-point line
explain: Forces the nail defender to cover a longer distance.

q: You get run off the 3-point line. Your read?
answer: Side Step 3: one side dribble for a clean 3 (not a long 2)

q: The defender closes out hard on your low shoulder. What do you do?
answer: Run Thru / Cash: face cut him on the catch

q: The ball is driven toward you on the perimeter. Your move?
answer: Drift: slide away from the ball

q: A baseline drive is coming at our strongside 5 in the dunker. What does he do?
answer: I-Cut: pop straight up to clear the baseline path
wrong: Seal his man on the block

q: You come off the ball screen and nobody engages you. Your read?
answer: Score

q: Off the ball screen, two defenders engage you (E2). Your read?
answer: Search: find the roll or the pop

q: Their big is in drop. Which counter floats a dribble to freeze him?
answer: Hang

q: They ICE our side ball screen. What does the screener do?
answer: Slip Roll: dive to the rim

q: They soft switch the ball screen. Our attack?
answer: Race Switch: drive it downhill

q: They blitz the ball screen. What are the 4 S passes?
answer: Short roll, Shake, See, Skip

q: What does "Wait for 2" mean?
answer: The handler waits for the screener to get on 2 feet (no moving screen)
wrong: Wait 2 seconds before using the screen

q: A small guard ends up guarding our big in the post. We call…
answer: Mouse in House

q: Their big ends up guarding our guard on the perimeter. We call…
answer: Moose on Loose

q: On a DHO your defender plays on the top side to stop the catch. Read?
answer: Dive: backcut right away

q: What is 4:1 spacing?
answer: Ball in the slot vs the mismatch, corners filled, big in the dunker (double gap)
wrong: Big at the top, guards in the corners

q: You pass on a switch. What is Boomerang?
answer: Back up 3 steps to create a runway, then catch & go on the pass back
wrong: Cut to the rim right away
Set a screen for the passer

q: You catch in the post. What are your first three things?
answer: Catch on 2 feet with 2 hands, chin it, check your inside shoulder

q: The post has no advantage. What do we run?
answer: Grenade: DHO uphill to a perimeter teammate, then slip or pop

q: You feed the post. What cut do you make?
answer: Speed cut: baseline side, sprint to the rim, out to the opposite corner
wrong: Stand and wait for the kick-out
Cut to the top of the key

q: Twirl means…
answer: The receiver slips back to screen the screener's defender
wrong: The screener rolls to the rim
The receiver curls to the basket
A dribble hand-off in the corner

q: The shot goes up on our end. What is TAG?
answer: Every one of our players gets top side of his defender as we shoot, ready for transition D

q: D-Trans: what do we take away in the first 6 seconds?
answer: Keys, free throws and 3s

q: Transition D: what is the WALL?
answer: Sprint to ball level to create a barrier that supports the ball
wrong: Two guards back at half court
Double the ball at half court

q: You're a help defender in the full court. What is PLUG?
answer: Weak and strong side help, parallel to your man on the ball's drive line
wrong: Deny your man the ball full court
Trap the ball at half court

q: Ball defender in transition: what is your job?
answer: Contain him and push him to his weak hand
wrong: Let him go and protect the rim
Force him to his strong hand

q: Closeout on a KLAY?
answer: Flyby: run at his shooting shoulder with your shooting hand (right on right), then rear-view contest

q: Closeout on a SHAQ (driver)?
answer: Absorb the drive

q: Closeout on a ROSE (shooter & driver)?
answer: Square: close out arm length away
wrong: Absorb the drive from far away

q: Closeout on a BOOK (shooter)?
answer: Body: forearm to his body

q: You're in a 2v1 and have to close out. What is SLICE?
answer: Close out on an angle that takes away the next pass, inviting the catch & go drive

q: GUARD SHELL: how do you play strong-hand and weak-hand attacks?
answer: Strong hand: CHEST. Weak hand: RUN (force flat drives outside the blocks and elbows)
wrong: Strong hand: RUN. Weak hand: CHEST

q: What is TRACE on the ball?
answer: An active hand above the ball at all times to pressure and block his vision

q: Helping from RIM on a scramble: VERTICALITY means…
answer: Stay vertical with hands up: jump inside the restricted area, stand your ground outside it

q: Who is NAIL, and what does he take on a paint drive?
answer: The top weak-side defender: he sinks and takes the 1st pass out
wrong: The bottom weak-side defender: he takes the 2nd pass
The defender next to the ball: he stunts
The ball defender: he stays on the ball

q: Who is LOW, and what is his job on rim help?
answer: The bottom weak-side defender: top-foot help and the 2nd pass
wrong: The top weak-side defender: the 1st pass
The rim protector: blocks the shot

q: What are our shrink spots (BEN)?
answer: Blocks, Elbows, Nail

q: "Be In to Get Out" means…
answer: Your body is IN to help, but your mind is on getting OUT to 3-point threats
wrong: Get in the paint and stay there
Get out to the shooter before helping

q: A help defender fakes help with his hands and feet, then gets back to his shooter. That is…
answer: Stunt

q: A teammate is beat with his hips open below the recovery line. The next help defender calls…
answer: PEEL

q: The shot goes up. What is HIT-FIND-GET?
answer: Hit your man with your forearm, turn and find the ball, go get it
wrong: Hit the floor, find your man, get back
Box out with your hands, then leak out
Jump first, then find your man

q: What is SANDWICH on the glass?
answer: An extra guard doubles their weak-side offensive rebounder
wrong: Two bigs box out the same man
The guard leaks out for a layup

q: The ball is swung. What is PIVOT & SPRINT?
answer: Sprint to your help spot during the ball's airtime so you're right on the catch
wrong: Pivot and wait for the catch
Deny the next pass from where you are

q: The 5 Ts of ball-screen defence are…
answer: Talk, Touch, Trace, Take, Tag

q: TAKE: what does the guard call, and what does the big do?
answer: Guard calls "BACK", the big recovers to his man
wrong: Big calls "ICE", the guard goes under

q: TRACE: who takes the low pocket pass, and who takes the high pocket?
answer: Big takes the low pocket; guard takes the high pocket
wrong: Guard takes the low; big takes the high

q: What colour is our DROP coverage?
answer: Brown

q: What colour is our ICE coverage?
answer: Blue

q: What colour is our SWITCH coverage?
answer: Gold

q: Their ball handler is an elite 3-point shooter. Which coverage puts our big at the level of the screen?
answer: Flat/Grey

q: Side ball screen on the outer third of the floor, call is ICE. Guard's job?
answer: Keep the ball from going middle (chest on his middle-side hip)

q: In ICE, the ball gets into the middle anyway. What do we do?
answer: Switch to Drop
explain: Ice/Blue: switch to Drop if ball enters middle.

q: In DROP, what does the big call, and where does he play?
answer: "LEFT/RIGHT", playing centerfield between ball and rim (Ball-You-Basket)
wrong: "SWITCH", at the level of the screen

q: In BLITZ/PINK, how long does the big stay on the ball?
answer: Until the dribble is picked up or retreats, then he sprints back with high hands

q: Switch/Gold: what does the Dscreener call?
answer: "TBD"

q: Peel vs a pick and pop: who takes who?
answer: The guard takes the popping big, the big defends the ball handler
wrong: The weak-side tag takes the popper

q: Pick-n-pop big or a non-shooting guard. Which coverage keeps matchups (big stays, guard goes under)?
answer: Squeeze

q: Their big is in KYP Drop on a handoff. What does the receiver's defender do in CHASE?
answer: Bust over the handoff, stay attached, force everything uphill & 1-way

q: A shooter comes off a down screen. Our coverage for the Dreceiver?
answer: Chase: attach and bust over

q: TOP LOCK vs an off-ball screen means…
answer: Stay on the high side of the screen and force everything to the baseline

q: Off-ball screens: where is the Dscreener's hand, and why?
answer: On the screener's back, in case we need to switch if the Dreceiver gets hit

q: A late paint switch on a bad beat to protect the rim is…
answer: Veer

q: ISO D: what is WEAK?
answer: Shade the ball handler to his weak hand and shrink the floor away from the ball
wrong: Force him to his strong hand

q: ISO D: what is SHIFT?
answer: LOW and RIM load to the ball early and pre-rotate

q: We want the ball out of a dangerous player's hands right now. The call?
answer: SMACK/SLAP: an immediate double team from the loaded side

q: Our base post coverage is WHITE. What is it?
answer: 3/4 top denial, slide behind on the pass, wall up and show hands

q: What is BLACK in post D?
answer: We front the post (box out from the front) to discourage the pass or force a lob over the top

q: Post catch, call is KICK. Who doubles, and from where?
answer: LOW doubles from the baseline side
wrong: Strong side defender from the top side

q: Post catch, call is BOMB. Who doubles, and from where?
answer: The strong side defender doubles from the top side

q: We're in BLACK. What does the fronting defender yell?
answer: "BLACK-BLACK-BLACK" to alert the help side

q: Black - Scram: LOW yells "SCRAM" on the post catch. What does the fronting guard do?
answer: Releases to the weak-side corner (LOW switches onto the post)

q: Post puts it on the floor. Hit ⇒ Dig to Smack means…
answer: Gap, dig, then double on the second post dribble with the nearest defender

q: End of game, we're up 2. Screens?
answer: "Stay before, switch after": no switches before the inbound, switch everything after

q: End of game, we're up 3. Screens?
answer: Switch before and after, and Pork when we can to stop a 3

q: When do we PORK (intentional foul)?
answer: Up 3 late, or at the end of a quarter when we have a foul to give
wrong: Any time they are in the bonus
When their best shooter has the ball

q: BLOB D (HAT): how do we guard screens?
answer: Fight over every screen, no switches (inbound defender protects the basket)

q: SMACK/TRAP at the end of a quarter means…
answer: Double team their hot player
